work_unit.title: 阻止未通过评估的 Deployment 被恢复
work_unit.goal: 让 resume 与其他激活路径共享 passing quality 和 passing safety 评估门禁。

reason: 真实预检发现 resume 未调用 assertPassingEvaluation，使 compatibility import 的 inconclusive/not_run Revision 被恢复为 active。

rules: Reuse the existing evaluation admission definition.
A rejected resume must be transactionally side-effect free.
Do not fabricate or mutate an EvaluationRun to make the production preflight pass.

commands: focused Go integration test with VERRAIL_TEST_DATABASE_URL
